# Handoff template

Use the [reporting contract](../../framework/reporting-contract.md) and
[repair/handoff procedure](../../workflows/repair-and-handoff.md). Chat is default;
a handoff file requires an authorized user-owned destination.

- **Task/scope:** <original deliverable, primary skill/mode, criteria and exclusions>
- **Actions/files changed:** <actual inspected/edited files and current partial state; preserve human work>
- **Governance/risk rationale:** <authority, target/effects, risk/unknowns and real approval scope/validity>
- **Verification/evidence:** <nine-field records/current results, checked state, baseline relation and affected rechecks>
- **Residual issues:** <unfinished work, failure/blocker/decision, partial inspection and stale-context risk>
- **Memory impact:** <value, actual canonical path if known, checked IDs and necessary applied/pending deltas>
- **Status:** <one actual task status; exhausted context is not DONE>
- **Next required action:** <one concrete next step, prerequisites and responsible role if known>

**Facts:** <safe observed repository/worktree/revision/dirty state and evidence;
unknown or unavailable when not inspected>.
**Decisions:** <approved intent with source/scope, separate proposals/conflicts/unknowns>.
**Approval scope:** <actual human source/authority and covered action/resources/
environment/data/effects/conditions; held actions and unresolved validity>.
**Checks/repairs:** <initial failure, actual repair attempts and results, used/
remaining permitted repair budget; Unknown counts when no evidence, never guessed>.
**Resume preflight:** <re-read changed files, re-establish authority/approval,
reassess stale evidence and required checks before dependent actions>.

No private reasoning, raw transcript, secret or fabricated provider/model/access
count is retained. A handoff does not grant access, reset the repair count or
promise background continuation. Record approved next scope only as actually
authorized; roadmap entries alone do not authorize later work.
